faq.q: What is Comet Retro Custom in GTA 6?
faq.a: Comet Retro Custom is a vehicle listed for GTA 6 on the GTA Fandom wiki, made in game by Pfister. The wiki entry is the only record of it. Rockstar has not named it in a trailer, a press release or on the Grand Theft Auto VI site, so this page records the wiki listing and marks it as a community source.

faq.q: Is Comet Retro Custom confirmed for GTA 6?
faq.a: No. A Fandom wiki page is written by fans, not by Rockstar. This site files Comet Retro Custom as community identified, at low confidence, for that reason. The entry stays at low confidence until Rockstar or a major outlet names it.

faq.q: What does the wiki say about Comet Retro Custom?
faq.a: The wiki gives 5 details. Manufacturer: Pfister. Class: Sports. Body style: 2-door coupe. Seats: 2. Listed price: $645,000 (from GTA Online, not GTA 6). Those are wiki fields copied as they stand. No figure here was measured in the game, because the game has not released.

faq.q: Where does this Comet Retro Custom information come from?
faq.a: From the GTA Fandom wiki page for Comet Retro Custom, collected by the outlawdb project on 2026-09-13 and released under CC BY-SA 3.0. The source link on this page opens the wiki page itself, so you can read the same entry.

faq.q: What is still unknown about Comet Retro Custom?
faq.a: Most of it. Comet Retro Custom rests on a fan wiki listing and nothing else. Top speed, handling and stats and a gta 6 price are both unpublished. Rockstar answers questions like this at launch, not before, so this page will change when it does.

faq.q: Will Comet Retro Custom be in the finished GTA 6?
faq.a: Not known. A wiki listing is a claim by a fan editor, not a Rockstar statement. Plenty of vehicle entries written before a launch never appear in the game. This site records the claim and the source, and marks the entry unconfirmed until that changes.
